description: National Olympic Committee of Kenya founded (14 Feb); IOC-recognised same year
Kenya National Sports Council formed to regulate sports organisations
Anti-doping concerns begin surfacing publicly around Kenyan athletics
Sports Act 2013 framework era; Sports Kenya and related bodies established under reform
Anti-Doping Agency of Kenya (ADAK) established; doping criminalised after WADA non-compliance ruling
Athlete/official corruption cases (Nike diversion, Rio theft) reach courts and IAAF ethics board
Government commits ~USD 5 million per year for five years to anti-doping to avert blanket ban
Ministry of Youth Affairs, Creative Economy and Sports 2023-2027 Strategic Plan; Talanta Hela talent-monetisation initiative
Revised National Sports Policy approved (April); SRC-approved athlete reward and welfare overhaul
figures: Olympic gold bonus raised from ~USD 5,800 to ~USD 23,200; daily allowances raised
source: People Daily; Pan African Visions; Kenyans.co.ke

figures: KES 16.69B total; ADAK KES 241M; Kenya Academy of Sports KES 245M; Sports Kenya KES 402M; Sports Registrar digitisation KES 2.3B; ~0.004% of national budget

description: Government announces KES 70M compensation for historically overlooked athletes; scholarship and post-career transition pathways proposed
